discovery.title: Japan’s new mission is heading to Mars’ moons to bring back samples
discovery.summary: Japan launched the Martian Moons eXploration mission to study Phobos and Deimos, with a planned sample return to Earth in 2031.
discovery.why_it_matters: Samples could help answer whether Mars’ small moons are captured asteroids or formed from material around Mars, while adding another international sample-return effort.
